question: Does confirmation from recently correlated assets identify a V1.7 reclaim that has economic support outside the signal coin?
single_variable: Gate otherwise eligible balanced nine-slot orders by five peer votes. A vote is a positive own-side peer log return in excess of BTC during the just-closed signal candle. Require at least three of five. Choose five nearest pre-key Pearson correlations on 60 consecutive 12H BTC-adjusted returns, with at least ten peer candidates. Exclude self and BTC. Economic control uses five middle-ranked correlations and the same voting rule. Coverage arm funds all applicants with both complete groups. No contemporaneous peer substitutions. Rank ties follow sorted native symbols.
baseline: Reuse the unaltered OKX volume/ATR queue, four real children and 10% of previous-hour average minute turnover. Fix ranking across these explicit subsets, readmit eligible applicants. Include 5bp market slippage sensitivity. The same periods were studied before; funding and exit depth unavailable.
inputs: Corrected native 360 symbol hourly history including verified retired names. Log returns need two full consecutive 12H bars; pre-key peer selection ends at key open. Peer votes are available at the same decision close, before next hourly open.
